name: Tavern Brawler
text: No abilities.
flavor: He starts every fight with a toast and ends it with a stool.

name: Vine-Crowned Bacchant
text: Haste (this can attack the turn it comes into play).
flavor: He dances straight from the wine-press into the battle line.

name: Masquerade Duelist
text: First strike (this deals combat damage before creatures without first strike).
flavor: Behind the gilded mask, a smile; behind the smile, a blade.

name: Courtier on the Chaise
text: Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): deal 1 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: He has not stood up since the spring, and his wit has only grown sharper.

name: Loafer of the Arbour
text: Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): rummage (draw a card, then discard a card).
flavor: There is always work to be done, and always a shady bench beside it.

name: Sleepy Baronet
text: Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): put a +1/+1 counter on this.
flavor: Each day he wakes a little later and a little heavier.

name: Fire-Eater of the Feast
text: When this enters, deal 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: The guests applaud. The guest nearest the stage stops applauding.

name: Gluttonous Baron
text: When this enters, you lose 2 life.
flavor: Seven courses, nine vintages, and still he rises hungry for more.

name: Masked Reveller
text: Carouse (if you already played another non-land card this turn): this has haste.
flavor: Behind a mask, every man is braver and none of them is sober.

name: Carousing Lancer
text: Haste (this can attack the turn it comes into play).
flavor: He charged the enemy line still holding his goblet, and never spilled a drop.

name: Satyr of the Drowsy Vineyard
text: Haste (this can attack the turn it comes into play). Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): put a +1/+1 counter on this.
flavor: He meant to join the raid. Then the afternoon grew warm.

name: Garlanded Festival Bull
text: When this enters, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: They lead him through the streets in flowers, and the crowd follows him into battle.

name: Toast of Fire
text: Deal 2 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: "To your health!" she cried, and lit the brandy.

name: Firecracker Garland
text: Deal 1 damage to target enemy creature. Carouse (if you already played another non-land card this turn): also deal 1 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: Strung across the square for the feast day, lit one at a time, aimed carelessly.

name: Spilled Brandy
text: Deal 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player, then rummage (draw a card, then discard a card).
flavor: One clumsy elbow, one candle, and the evening became memorable.

name: Rowdy Chorus
text: Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn. Carouse (if you already played another non-land card this turn): they get an additional +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: Nobody remembers the second verse, so they sing the first one louder.

name: Flaming Flagon
text: Deal 3 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: It was poured for him. It simply arrived faster than he expected.

name: Banquet Flambe
text: Deal 4 damage to target enemy creature.
flavor: The chef insists it is meant to burn that brightly.

name: Carnival Brazier

abilities.text: Tap, pay 1 life: deal 1 damage to the enemy player.

text: Tap, pay 1 life: deal 1 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: It warms the dancers, lights the masks, and singes everyone who stands too close.

name: Festival Drum

abilities.text: R, Tap: creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

text: R, Tap: creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: When the drum begins, even the sleepiest baron finds his feet.

name: Duelist of the Velvet Court
text: First strike. Whenever this attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
flavor: He has never lost a duel, nor an argument about wine.

name: Masked Firebreather
text: Whenever this attacks, deal 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: Every performance ends with a bow and a scorched front row.

name: Jester of the Lazy Court
text: Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): deal 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: His jokes are cruel, his aim is crueller, and he delivers both lying down.

name: Hostess of the Lantern Garden
text: Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): put a +1/+0 counter on target creature you control.
flavor: She never leaves her couch, yet no guest ever leaves her table hungry.

name: Fencing Master of the Masque
text: First strike. Carouse (if you already played another non-land card this turn): this has haste.
flavor: He teaches only at night, and only to students who arrive already drunk.

name: Hierophant of the Bacchanal
text: Haste. When this enters, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: "Tonight there is no tomorrow. Drink, and charge!"

name: Margrave of the Long Table
text: Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): put two +1/+1 counters on this and you lose 2 life.
flavor: Every evening he swears it will be his last feast, and every evening he is right about nothing.

name: Second Bottle
text: Deal 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player. Carouse (if you already played another non-land card this turn): also deal 2 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: The first bottle is for the guests. The second is for the host's enemies.

name: Satisfaction at Dawn
text: Deal 3 damage to target enemy creature. Carouse (if you already played another non-land card this turn): creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: Insulted at supper, challenged at midnight, buried by breakfast.

name: Pyre-Dancer's Whirl
text: Deal 2 damage to each enemy creature. You lose 2 life.
flavor: The dancers spin closer to the bonfire with every verse.

name: Empty the Cellar
text: Rummage twice (each time, draw a card, then discard a card). Then deal 2 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: By the end of the night the cellar was empty, and so, curiously, were the guests.

name: Bottomless Wine Cask
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, rummage (draw a card, then discard a card).
flavor: Pleasure that never ends is its own slow wound.

name: Carnival Masks
text: Carouse (if you already played another non-land card this turn): creatures you control have first strike.
flavor: Behind a painted face, the clumsiest guest moves like a fencing master.

name: Salamander Juggler
text: Haste. Whenever this attacks, deal 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: Three living flames in the air, and not one of them is happy about it.

name: Prince of Idle Hours
text: Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): deal 2 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: He has not lifted a finger in years. He has never needed to.

name: Master of the Midnight Duel
text: First strike, haste. Carouse (if you already played another non-land card this turn): this gets +2/+0.
flavor: He fights only after the last dance, when the candles gutter and the witnesses are asleep.

name: Archduke of the Endless Feast
text: Haste. At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life.
flavor: His banquet has lasted eleven years. His liver has filed several complaints.

name: Giant of the Groaning Board
text: Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): put a +1/+1 counter on this, then rummage (draw a card, then discard a card).
flavor: He sat down to dinner a year ago. The table has since been rebuilt around him twice.

name: Grand Conflagration
text: Deal 5 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player.
flavor: The fireworks were the finale. Nobody had planned for the encore.

name: Night Without End
text: Creatures you control get +3/+0 until end of turn. You lose 3 life.
flavor: At dawn they drew the curtains and called it midnight again.

name: Carnival of Cinders
text: Deal 3 damage to each creature and 3 damage to the enemy player. You lose 1 life.
flavor: The carnival ended as all carnivals end: in ashes, and someone else's house.

name: Lanterns of the Pleasure Garden
text: Creatures you control have haste.
flavor: Under the paper lanterns no one waits for anything.

name: Vessaria, Mistress of the Undying Feast
text: Idle (at the end of your turn, if this is untapped and didn't attack): deal 1 damage to each enemy creature and 2 damage to the enemy player.
flavor: She raises a cup to every guest; the guests who drink do not rise again.

name: Brandimarte, Prince of Fire-Eaters
text: Haste, first strike. Whenever this attacks, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: He drinks fire, duels for sport, and has never once been on time for his own wedding.

name: The Undying Bonfire

abilities.text: Pay 2 life: deal 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player. Use this only once each turn.

text: At the beginning of your upkeep, deal 1 damage to each creature and 1 damage to the enemy player, and you lose 1 life. Pay 2 life: deal 1 damage to any enemy creature or the enemy player. Use this only once each turn.
flavor: It was lit for one feast day. Nobody remembers which, and nobody can put it out.
